turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

Thank you, Claire, your order is verified. A refund above 1,000 lei is decided by a person on the team. Your order is 1,350 lei, so I have passed your request to a colleague. They will take over and tell you the next steps. I can't promise the refund until they decide.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

rule.ro: Orice rambursare de peste 1.000 de lei o decide o persoană din echipă.
rule.en: A person on the team decides any refund above 1,000 lei.

input.summary: Verified customer Claire Fontaine wants to return order SC-3744 (Last Lantern, limited, 40x50 cm, 1350 RON, delivered 2026-11-09) for a refund because she ordered the wrong size. Refund is above 1,000 lei, so a person must decide. No request filed.
